comparison.objective: Cut a cable tie from a bundle without damaging insulation, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1441 stabilizes a rolling bundle while precisely positioning and closing flush cutters; the candidate counterholds a screw while tightening a jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1441 requires complete tie removal, no cable nick, tool return, and bundle stability; the candidate requires retained angle and repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Damage-avoiding cutting is meaningfully different from adjustment and locknut control.
